title: Where can I create assets?
author: SeratoninSniffingDog
selftext:
Hello

I don't want to publish a game or something. I just want to play around and create my own game. Just for the fun and to learn something. I can code and I can use Unity. But usually my projects fail because I don't want to pay a lot of money for a designer (or for the music tbh) and I'm looking for a way to create the assets. I would like to start with a 2d SNES Style graphics.  
But if you know any good ressource for generating 3d assets, feel free. I would be pretty happy about that too. Thanks for the help :)

comments.author: Putrid_Clue_2127
comments.body: For me it's: I work up a prompt with Claude to make sure the artwork fits a style or standard with the rest of the artwork. The prompt is formatted for chatgpt. I create the game art in chatgpt. I take ChatGPTs output and run it through Tripo. From Tripo it goes back to Claude to be refined and worked into whatever its purpose is

replies.author: Grimmy66
replies.body:
He didn't say free :) but there is a free demo and at $29.99 the full version is almost free.  
  
You could try Blockbench though which IS free ,but it started to annoy me after a while as it has its limitations.. no bevel for a start!!!

comments.author: Shugu11
comments.body: Just open chatgpt in claude and ask claude to generate the images with chatgpt :) unlimited generations on a 20$ plan. I did the same for my kidsgameclub app ([Kids Game Club - Apps on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kidsgameclub.app))

comments.author: starmakereden
comments.body: You can try downloading Blender & connect it with an MCP. Personally, tried that on some assets and I like the results. However, I don't usually do it because directing an AI to code and art at the same time is hell. For music, I just source them from free sites like Pixabay.

comments.author: RsetX
comments.body: If you want to create 2d animation you could give a chance to my tool https://shaddafare.itch.io/sprite-sheep It animate characters and objects from a first sprite or a reference image. It works in local with your gpu
